subject: Request: Research trial credits and short extension for Fernandez Language Ethics Lab
messages:
From: Prof. Alessandra Ramos <a.ramos@fernandez.edu>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Kim <sam.kim@fernandez.edu>
Date: Tue, 7 Oct 2025 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Trial credits for Fernandez Language Ethics Lab pilot?

Hi Hannah,

I'm Alessandra Ramos, PI for the Language Ethics Lab at Fernandez University. We're running a small pilot studying bias in conversational models when applied to historical learner texts. Our team of 3 (PI + 2 grad students) would like to extend an existing 30-day trial for four more weeks and request an additional $4,000 in credits to complete evaluation runs and annotation tooling.

Key items:
- IRB approval is attached (low-risk, de-identified transcripts).
- We expect ~400k tokens of eval + 50k tokens for annotation tooling across the extension.
- Project is academically funded; we can provide a one-paragraph acknowledgement for Redwood in resulting papers if helpful.

Would Redwood consider a short-term top-up and an extension on the trial? Happy to share our proposal (I can attach) and hop on a 20-min call.

Thanks,

Alessandra Ramos
Professor, Language Ethics Lab
Fernandez University
Attachment: irb-approval-2025.pdf (PDF)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Prof. Alessandra Ramos <a.ramos@fernandez.edu>
Cc: Sam Kim <sam.kim@fernandez.edu>
Date: Tue, 7 Oct 2025 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial credits for Fernandez Language Ethics Lab pilot?

Hi Alessandra — thanks for reaching out and for the IRB. This sounds straightforward and aligned with our academic credit program. A couple quick clarifying questions so I can route for approval:

1) Can you attach the short project proposal with expected monthly token curve (rough per-day averages)?
2) Do you need private deployment / data residency, or is hosted API acceptable for the runs?
3) Any required contractual language (e.g., restrictions on attribution, embargoes) beyond standard academic acknowledgement?

If you can drop the proposal here I will loop in the grants/credits team for a decision. Assuming usage matches the estimate, approvals for ~$4k and a 4-week extension are usually straight-line but I need to confirm with finance.

If easier, we can set up a 20-minute slot tomorrow.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
Calendar: https://calendly.com/hannah-redwood/20
From: Prof. Alessandra Ramos <a.ramos@fernandez.edu>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Kim <sam.kim@fernandez.edu>
Date: Wed, 8 Oct 2025 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial credits for Fernandez Language Ethics Lab pilot?

Hi Hannah — attached is the short proposal ("fernandez-research-proposal.pdf"). Highlights:
- 4-week extension, estimate 450k tokens total across eval/annotation tooling.
- No PII, all data de-identified per IRB; we will not retain model outputs beyond evaluation windows.
- Hosted API is fine; no private deployment required.
- We request a short credit top-up (~$4k) and an extension to the trial expiration date (was 2025-10-12).

We're flexible on timing — would prefer to start next week if possible.

Thanks for helping us move this along.

— Alessandra
Attachment: fernandez-research-proposal.pdf (PDF)

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding a request from Fernandez University. Small academic pilot: 4-week extension + $4k in credits. IRB and short proposal attached. Hosted API only; no special contractual terms requested beyond acknowledgement.

Usage estimate: ~450k tokens over 4 weeks. No PII. They'd like to start next week.

Recommended ask: approve $4,000 in promotional credits and extend trial expiry to 2025-11-09. If approved, I'll send the credits and a short terms note.

Notes for approval:
- Academic: yes; provide acknowledgement language after approval.
- Region: US campus; standard hosted environment OK.
- No SOC2 docs requested in thread but we have them if they ask.

Thanks — Hannah

- $4,000 promotional credit applied to the Fernandez Lab trial account (Deal DL-4379).
- Trial expiry extended to 2025-11-09 (4 weeks from original expiry).
